comment: No source is published. The frequency base is 20 times 900 to the power of the cutoff knob, giving 20Hz to 18000Hz, but when the 1V/oct jack is connected that base is replaced with 261.6256Hz and the knob is never read again, so a patched cable sitting at 0V pins the filter to C4. Resonance is 0.5 times 30 to the power of the knob and decay is 0.05 times 100 to the power of the knob. The nine model names are Harmonic string, Odd-harmonic tube, Stiff string, Tuned bar, Free-free bar, Circular membrane, Square membrane, Bell and Plate / cymbal; the ninth is shortened to plate on its line to keep it inside the line length, and the model knob fades between neighbouring pairs, which the tooltip shows as one name, an arrow, the next name and a percentage. The expander is found through the right-hand expander slot and its model is checked, so only a Modal Filter Expander counts and only on the right. Nothing in the plugin reads a channel count, so every port is mono; the maker's description of the expander as adding polyphonic voices means several resonators, not Rack polyphony. The panel menu also carries Reload panel and Poll SVG for reload, which every module in this plugin has and which only reload the panel artwork; they are left out.
